name: Snakebite Shield
body:
Aura moderate conjuration; CL 10th; Slot none; Price 9,170 gp; Weight 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +1 heavy steel shield bears the image of an elaborate serpent, a common symbol of Ares. Once per day as a free action, you can animate the snake to make one attack from the shield (this attack is in addition to any actions performed by the wielder), biting with the wielder’s base attack bonus and dealing 2d6 piercing damage plus poison. The snake has a reach of 10 feet.

Poison (Ex)

Bite—injury; save Fort DC 17; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Con; cure 2 consecutive saves.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells summon nature’s ally V; Cost 4,670 gp
